high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white portrait of Christopher Nolan, a renowned filmmaker, positioned on the right side. The left side of the image contains a block of text with a quote attributed to Christopher Nolan. The quote reads: "When introducing a character in the script, focus less on physical description, and more on their psychological nature and personality. Think in terms of 'They're the kind of person who...'" The text is presented in a clean, sans-serif font, making it easy to read against the white background.
